after:
Stop spending Monday morning texting people to cover sick calls.

Tidepool is shift scheduling for independent veterinary clinics. It drafts your weekly rota from staff availability and your coverage rules, and when someone calls in sick, it texts eligible staff and fills the shift for you.

Start your 30-day free trial

No card required. Built for clinics with 2-12 vets and 5-40 staff.

…

"My staff won't install another app."

They don't need to. Shift offers arrive as plain SMS, and staff reply YES to take one.

…

Is it AI?

No. The rota builder is a constraint solver: it builds the rota from the availability and coverage rules you give it.
caption: Every claim traces to product-notes.md. "AI-powered", "enterprise-grade" and "thousands of customers" are gone. The run also refused to subtract two survey numbers from different samples.
